messages:
Maya (marketing): heads up — noticed a spike in SLA misses for inbound webinar leads from APAC this morning. many are landing without enriched company info and immediately being routed to US SDRs. 😕
Sam (revops): ugh. any idea if enrichment lag or routing rule changed?
Maya (marketing): enrichment TTL seems to be 0s for a subset of webhook events? looks like the enrichment job is delayed ~30-90s. we currently expire the claim window at 20s.
Eli (growth): that mismatch will definitely cause premature round-robin assignment. proposal: add a "handover grace window" of +60s when enrichment flag is pending for geo=APAC, and tag lead with `pending_enrich` so UI shows hold state. can canary to 5%.
Jordan (sales): +1 on grace window. sales folks are seeing handoffs with missing titles which kills productivity. question: if hubspot owner is null after grace, what owner do we fallback to?
Ria (revops): fallback plan: set geo-anchored default owner per region (e.g., `apac-default-sdr`) instead of global unassigned. also emit an alert if routed->owner is default more than X/min.
Sam (revops): technical quickfix we can ship now: in routing service, if `enrichment_status == pending` && `source == webinar` then move lead to a short-hold queue and extend claim window to 80s. that'll avoid immediate round-robin dispatch. can patch in next 30m.
Maya (marketing): perfect. that should reduce noisy handoffs for the webinar campaign. please also surface a small banner to SDRs: "enrichment pending — fresh lead" so they know to wait for a follow-up ping. :information_source:
Sam (revops): grabbing logs now — small sample webhook payload: 
```json
{"event":"lead.create","region":"apac","owner":null,"enrichment_status":"pending","received_at":"2026-03-22T08:12:03Z"}
```
Eli (growth): thanks — confirms pattern. can we also tweak round-robin to prefer local region buckets first before global overflow? keeps handoffs closer to timezone.
Ria (revops): yes — route-bot already supports bucket priority. we just need to flip the `region_first` flag for webinar flows. low-risk.
Jordan (sales): any impact on SFDC owner sync? if hubspot owner null and we use geo-default, we must ensure SF mapping uses `owner_tag` so records don’t flip back to unassigned.
Sam (revops): noted — will add `owner_source: routing_service` metadata so sync job respects it. also add a 5m audit so we can reconcile later.
route-bot: routing-service: canary toggle `region_first=true` on channel `webinar` ready for deploy.
deploy-bot: deploy queued — revops/patch/routing-hold (canary 5%) by @Sam in 12m.
Maya (marketing): can we add a short SLA doc blurb for the webinar team so ops knows to expect the new 80s handover grace? i'll update the campaign runbook.
Eli (growth): I'll coordinate on metrics — watch claim_rate, enrichment_completion_time, and manual-claim % for the next 2 hrs. will post charts.
Sam (revops): patch merged to canary. monitoring alert: `lead.routed_with_enrichment_pending` set to warn at 10/min.
Jordan (sales): thanks team — pls DM me if any flakiness. we'll pause SDR outreach if we see >30% missing enrichment after grace window.
Maya (marketing): awesome. will notify webinar ops and close loop with the partner. :white_check_mark:
